stem.text: Hydrocarbon X is saturated. Each molecule contains one ring of carbon atoms.
The mass spectrum of hydrocarbon X is measured.
The peak representing the M+ ion is $14\,\text{mm}$ high.
The peak representing the $[\text{M}+1]^{+}$ ion is $0.77\,\text{mm}$ high.
What is the $m/e$ value for the M+ ion of X?
